name: Chief (growth coach)
tagline: A quiet daily check-in that keeps you to one habit at a time
description: Instead of stacking goals on top of each other, it asks you to carry a single practice and then enquires after it every morning. Come the weekend it looks back in two passes: once over what genuinely took place, once over what that suggests for the days ahead. Attention before appetite, progress without strain.
author: rafdotworks
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
